items.title: Pay 'processing fee' to receive promised refund
items.quote: Damit wir sie auszahlen können, überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von 49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for this payment: 'bis zum 27.11.2026'. This is not a deadline set by a German authority (no deemed-delivery or §§187-193 BGB counting applies), so the date is taken as printed. 27.11.2026 is a Friday and not a public holiday in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed. Due date = 2026-11-27.

warnings: This letter shows the classic pattern of an advance-fee ('Vorkasse') scam: an unsolicited, unusually large 'refund' is promised, but only after the recipient first pays a separate 'processing fee' — legitimate German refund processes never require the recipient to pay a fee up front.

The payee IBAN (CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600) is a Cypriot account; checked structurally it is a well-formed IBAN, but a valid checksum says nothing about who owns the account, and a foreign account for a supposed German energy-cost refund is a strong mismatch.

There is no genuine German public or statutory body called 'Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie'; the sender's address and phone number are in Cyprus, inconsistent with a German consumer-energy refund authority.
The sentence 'Verstreicht die Frist, verfällt Ihr Anspruch endgültig' creates artificial time pressure, a typical scam tactic to push victims into paying quickly without checking.

Recommendation: do not transfer any money to the stated IBAN and do not treat this as a genuine refund; verify independently (e.g. with the actual energy supplier or consumer protection agency such as Verbraucherzentrale) before taking any action.

Compare it with earlier letters or the sender's official website; if a letter or email says the account has changed, confirm that through contact details you already know before paying. For a euro transfer to this account the bank also checks the payee's name against the account before it is sent (Empfängerüberprüfung, required in the euro area since 9 October 2025): if it reports no match or only a close one, or says the check was not possible, do not pay until you have confirmed the account.","disclaimer":"Information, not legal or financial advice: what the IBAN's own characters show, checked by Ordnung's code. It cannot tell whether the account exists or who holds it."}
